title: Ordered Set: K-th Smallest Element
statement:
You are given N numbers inserted one by one into an ordered multiset. After all insertions, answer Q queries: for each query k, print the k-th smallest element (1-indexed) currently in the multiset.

An ordered set keeps elements sorted, allowing O(log N) rank-based access.
inputFormat:
The first line contains N.
The second line contains N integers to insert.
The third line contains Q.
The next Q lines each contain an integer k.
outputFormat: Q lines, each the k-th smallest element in the multiset.
